To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a decrease in the contribution of C..C interactions to the Hirshfield surface and a decrease in the logP value are associated with a decrease in the cytotoxic activity of the compounds.
the cytotoxic activity of the studied flavonoid and coumaranone derivatives decreases as the percentage of C...H interactions on their Hirshfeld surfaces increases.

the cytotoxic activity of the presented compounds decreases with increasing contribution of C...O interactions to the Hirsheld surface, whereas the cytotoxic activity increases with increasing contribution of O...H interactions to the Hirsfeld surface.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between cytotoxic activity and the Hirshfeld potential of a series of flavone and chromone derivatives.
the interplay between the Hirshfeld potential of a molecule and the cytotoxic activities of a set of six biologically active flavonoid andchromanone derivatives.
the relationship between the cytotoxic activity and the molecular structure of the compounds.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is a correlation between the percentage contributions of C...C, H...H, and H...C contacts to the Hirshedl surface and the cytotoxic activities of flavonoid derivatives.
the cytotoxic activity of the presented flavonoid and coumaranone compounds is dependent on the presence of a C...O interaction in the crystal structure.
the percentage contributions of H...H and C...C close-contact contributions to the Hirsheld surface are the best indicators for predicting cytotoxic activity.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the cytotoxic activities of flavonoid compounds are related to the intermolecular interactions of the molecules, and this can be quantified using Hirshfeld surfaces.
the cytotoxic activity of flavonoids and chromanones can be predicted from their crystallographic properties.
a higher percentage of C...C and C...H contacts in the Hirshfeld fingerprint of a compound is associated with a higher cytotoxic activity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the cytotoxic activities of compounds I–VI are not only related to the molecular structure but also to their intermolecular interactions and the Hirshfeld surfaces.
Hirshfeld surface analysis is a valuable tool for predicting the biological activity of flavonoid derivatives.
the cytotoxic activity of the presented crystal structure is related to the percentage of C...C and O...H contacts to its Hirshfeld surface, as well as its logP value.
